## Better
- Two modules that share one CAFD keep their own My coding apart, also when the file was opened with E-Sys's own Edit FDL.
- Ticked changes in "What can I code?" are cleared when another coding file opens.
- Re-apply my coding saves without freezing the window.
- Read and edit stops if you click another module or another car connects before the read starts.
- Backups and working copies are never left half-written after a power cut.
- The coding editor stays smoother while setting names load.
